column1: Jake McCarthy stands out as the top pick, leading off with strong hit consistency and a favorable platoon edge against Matt Waldron. CJ Abrams offers similar reliability at the top of the order, also benefiting from a soft matchup and steady contact rates. Xavier Edwards and Freddie Freeman provide additional options, each with a solid track record and advantageous splits, but McCarthy’s combination of recent performance and matchup makes him the most dependable choice today.
